findings.claim: Immediate selection evidence and descendant credit disagree in kind, not just magnitude. Endpoint (selection) contrasts are large and coherent for pair_kernel_1.5/2.5 (endpoint_effects:9,10; positive_batch_fraction 1.0) and landmark_00_occupancy3 (endpoint_effects:15), whereas the survival table's strongest entries are much smaller (survival_effects:0 landmark_00_soft_mass effect_z 0.365; survival_effects:100 landmark_10_soft_mass 0.234) and mostly non-significant after BH. The actual later-label calculation is recorded joint-head credit at terminal index 99 (score_time 0.99, state_time 1.0), not decoded terminal affinity; decoded_terminal_learning_labels_available is false, so last-record credit cannot be presented as final affinity benefit. Ancestral coverage is thin: 349 nodes have fewer than 3 ancestors and 531 fewer than 6, so survivor bias is expected and the selection-vs-survival comparison is unavailable at the affinity level.

Multiplicity-adjusted support changes the ranking relative to point estimates. Under raw_covariance the largest whole_window_mean magnitudes are global_centroid_y/z (branch_adjusted:1,2) and landmark_02_softmin (branch_adjusted:20), but their q values are 0.69, 0.97 and 0.33 with same_sign_batch_fraction 0.43, 0.36 and 0.79. The only features with q<0.05 and high batch agreement are pair_kernel_1.5 and pair_kernel_2.5 (branch_adjusted:86 q=0.081, 87 q=0.077 in adjusted_covariance; 240 q=0.019, 241 q=0.045 in adjusted_correlation, same_sign 0.93) and the joint RMS features (branch_adjusted:228,230,305,307, q<=0.0003, same_sign 0.93-1.0). A point-estimate ranking would prioritize centroid and softmin; an uncertainty-and-coverage ranking prioritizes pair_kernel_1.5/2.5 and joint_internal/innovation RMS.

Independent-batch agreement and opposing observations constrain the pair_kernel direction. pair_kernel_1.5 and 2.5 are positive in 0.93 of 14 batches with q<0.05 in both raw and adjusted correlation (branch_adjusted:163,164,240,241), and joint_internal_RMS_A and joint_innovation_RMS_A are negative in 0.93-1.0 of batches (branch_adjusted:228,230,305,307). The counterexample that would weaken a pair_kernel_1.5/2.5 direction is a batch with negative sign; the supplied same_sign_batch_fraction of 0.93 (13/14) means one batch opposes, so the direction is reproducible but not unanimous. shape_yy is the only other feature with q<0.05 and same_sign 1.0 (branch_adjusted:158,235), but its effect is negative and its batch fraction is 1.0 only for the raw/adjusted correlation form.

Local coordinate information is separable from global pose and shape. The joint diagnostics show innovation_native_alignment and teacher_innovation_contrast_alignment are positive and significant (joint_diagnostics:1,11, p~1e-9, positive_batch_fraction 1.0), while observed_child_score_gain is negative and significant (joint_diagnostics:2, p=1.8e-7, positive_batch_fraction 0.0). The teacher contrast decomposes into internal fraction 0.79, translation 0.13 and rotation 0.08 (joint_diagnostics:14,12,13), so most of the contrast is internal rather than rigid motion. The joint_internal_RMS_A and joint_innovation_RMS_A effects (branch_adjusted:151,153,74,76) are the adjusted diagnostics that carry this; the region moments themselves are not rigid-motion residuals. The extent that should retain freedom is the internal/regional coordinate field (landmark local covariance and pair kernels), while global centroid and shape should not be treated as the informative axis.

Coherent joint coordinate patterns and isolated marginal descriptors give different evidence. The pair_kernel_1.5/2.5 features are coherent across raw and adjusted covariance and correlation (branch_adjusted:86,87,163,164,240,241) with same_sign 0.79-0.93, whereas shape_yy is an isolated marginal descriptor that is significant only in the correlation form (branch_adjusted:158,235) and not in the covariance form (branch_adjusted:4,81). The joint_internal_RMS_A and joint_innovation_RMS_A features (branch_adjusted:228,230) are the coupling diagnostics; averaging incompatible conformations into a single target is not supported because the covariance and correlation forms disagree in sign for several shape entries.

The supplied continuous contrast functions span the full observed support [0.0,0.49] with no extrapolation allowed (extrapolation_allowed false for all 200 rows). Every row has polynomial_accepted false and method observed_node_linear, so no validated polynomial fit exists; the relative_node_RMSE values range from about 0.28 to 0.997, and sign_changes range from 1 to 13 with strong_sign_conflicts up to 21. A constant rule is therefore not supported by fit fidelity, and a time-conditioned rule would require validated fits or observed-node interpolation that the supplied evidence does not provide. The curve_support audit selected 24 curves under a rule requiring relative_rmse<=0.35, strong_sign_conflict_nodes_eq 0 and quiet_node_large_fit_fraction<=0.1, but the listed curve_fidelity_audit entries all have relative_node_rmse 0.39-0.93 and strong_sign_conflict_nodes 0-15, so the selected set is not the same as the audited set. A contrast curve is not an absolute reward target.

Population-contrast changes and parent-child increment contrasts differ, and the turnover residual is an accounting diagnostic. For landmark_00_local_cxx the population_rate is -0.058 (turnover:12), the edge_rate is -4.34 (turnover:13) and the turnover_residual_rate is +4.29 (turnover:14, p=0.002, positive_batch_fraction 0.86). The same pattern appears for landmark_00_local_cyy (turnover:15,16,17), landmark_01_local_cyy (turnover:45,46,47), landmark_04_local_cxx (turnover:132,133,134), landmark_07_local_cxx (turnover:222,223,224), landmark_07_local_cyy (turnover:225,226,227), landmark_08_local_cxx (turnover:252,253,254), landmark_08_local_cyy (turnover:255,256,257), landmark_16_local_cyy (turnover:495,496,497), landmark_17_local_cxx (turnover:522,523,524), landmark_19_local_cxx (turnover:582,583,584) and landmark_19_local_cyy (turnover:585,586,587). The residual is large and positive where the edge rate is large and negative, which is consistent with changing cohort composition and score reclassification rather than within-path change; the residual is not a causal selection effect or atom velocity.

Parent-child increment contrasts are mostly not significant after BH. The largest increment effects are landmark_00_softmin (increment_effects:14, q=0.046, success_failure_integrated_rate_z -4.91), landmark_00_occupancy3 (increment_effects:15, q=0.081, +4.28), shape_xx (increment_effects:3, q=0.095, -3.70), shape_yy (increment_effects:4, q=0.16, -3.85), shape_xz (increment_effects:7, q=0.21, +3.00), pair_kernel_2.5 (increment_effects:10, q=0.21, +3.96), pair_kernel_7.0 (increment_effects:13, q=0.21, -3.14), landmark_03_occupancy5 (increment_effects:25, q=0.16, -3.02), landmark_06_occupancy5 (increment_effects:34, q=0.26, -2.87), landmark_13_softmin (increment_effects:53, q=0.30, +1.79) and landmark_13_occupancy5 (increment_effects:55, q=0.28, +2.48). Only landmark_00_softmin reaches q<0.05, and its sign is negative, opposite to the positive endpoint effect for landmark_00_occupancy3. The increment evidence therefore does not support a within-path change claim for the pair_kernel direction.

The information audit compares geometric nearest teacher under sparse salient fields versus Hungarian fixed-frame RMS with leave-one-batch exclusion. The compressed_choice_excess_fixed_RMS_A is 0.081 (CI 0.070-0.092), compressed_choice_fixed_RMS_A is 0.564 (CI 0.499-0.620), compressed_choice_proper_rigid_RMS_A is 0.529 (CI 0.468-0.582), top4_teacher_overlap is 0.470 (CI 0.427-0.515), compressed_chosen_teacher_score_correlation is 0.102 (CI 0.065-0.140) and full_chosen_teacher_score_correlation is 0.064 (CI 0.021-0.103). The audit limitations state this is not the full score-weighted reward or its FLOWR Jacobian, nonnegative excess distance is by construction, proper rigid alignment retains fixed Hungarian correspondence, node summaries describe correlated within-batch candidates, and teacher score correlations are observational and not a fitted or independently validated affinity predictor. The joint diagnostics show teacher_contrast_coherence 0.81, teacher_control_root_ESS 1.30, teacher_score_gap 0.17, teacher_noise_RMS_A 0.067, teacher_lower_rejected_fraction 0.33, teacher_expected_probability_advantage 0.007 and teacher_sign_calibration_cosine 0.97, all descriptive within-selector associations with batch as the independent unit.

The teacher modes are static: source configs/experiments/steer_dependency_v1/static.json.gz, dynamic_source configs/experiments/skill_ablation_v1/endpoint_reference.json.gz, count 28, assignment_rms_A_quantiles [0.446, 0.863, 1.050], 20 landmarks in Angstrom, temperature_edits false. The incumbent program D2_without_trajectory_static has teacher_neighbors 4, pointcloud_delta_A 1.0, mixture_temperature 0.5, teacher_endpoint_temperature_A2 4.0, teacher_score_beta 0, time_ramp_power 0.0, window [0.0,0.5], coordinate_representation predicted_endpoint_world_A, derivative_path flowr_endpoint_vjp, topology_policy free native graph transitions, and constraints max_atom_step_A 0.15, max_cumulative_rms_A 6.0, severe_receptor_clash_A 0.8, backtrack_attempts 7. The allowed edits are pointcloud_delta_A [0.5,1.0,2.0], region_index evidence-bound landmark, teacher_neighbors [2,4,8], temporal_region_index evidence-bound landmark and verified continuous salience, temporal_teacher_blend [0.25,0.5,1.0]. Temperatures are immutable task parameters and no temperature edit is permitted.

Regional enrichment and change-rate effects identify which regions add information beyond common motion. The strongest enrichment_z entries are landmark_00_soft_mass 0.639 (regional_effects:0, q=0.0002), landmark_02_local_dy 0.405 (regional_effects:22, q=0.0001), landmark_06_local_dy 0.425 (regional_effects:62, q=0.0001), landmark_09_local_dy 0.325 (regional_effects:92, q=0.0005), landmark_14_local_dy 0.350 (regional_effects:142, q=0.0002), landmark_18_local_dy 0.425 (regional_effects:182, q=0.0004). The parent_edge_contrast_rate_z entries are larger for local_cxz and local_cyz at landmarks 00, 01, 03, 05, 07, 11, 12, 13, 15, 16, 17, 19 (regional_effects:408,418,438,457,478,518,538,557,568,598), with values 2.6-3.9 and q 0.02-0.17. The enrichment_change_rate_z entries are mostly non-significant. The regions that should retain freedom are the local covariance and pair-kernel fields around landmarks 00, 02, 06, 09, 14, 18, while global centroid and shape should not be treated as the informative axis.

The joint RMS diagnostics are the strongest and most reproducible coordinate evidence. joint_innovation_RMS_A and joint_internal_RMS_A are negative with q<=0.0003 and same_sign_batch_fraction 0.93-1.0 in both raw and adjusted covariance and correlation (branch_adjusted:74,76,151,153,228,230,305,307). joint_translation_RMS_A is also negative but weaker (branch_adjusted:75,152,229,306, q 0.01-0.09). The joint diagnostics show innovation_RMS_A 0.072, teacher_contrast_RMS_A 0.066 and teacher_noise_RMS_A 0.067 (joint_diagnostics:0,3,7), all descriptive within-selector associations. These are coordinate diagnostics, not physical interaction energies or evidence of neural-module causation.

hypotheses.claim: A testable coordinate intervention on the pair_kernel_1.5/2.5 field: observable is the pair_kernel_1.5 and 2.5 shell density; intended response is an increase in the favorable-minus-comparison contrast; target origin is the landmark-adjacent pair-distance shell; spatial scale is 1.5-2.5 A with sigma 0.75 A; temporal scale is the full observed support [0.0,0.49]. The discriminating failure condition is a batch with negative sign on pair_kernel_1.5/2.5 or a q value above 0.05 in the adjusted correlation form. The permitted reward recipe that could express this is the pointcloud endpoint reward with region_index set to an evidence-bound landmark and teacher_neighbors in [2,4,8]; the pair-kernel term itself is not in the executing pointcloud scalar, so the hypothesis remains descriptive unless the region attention is validated.

A testable coordinate intervention on the internal/innovation RMS field: observable is joint_internal_RMS_A and joint_innovation_RMS_A; intended response is a decrease in internal RMS and innovation RMS; target origin is the internal coordinate field after rigid alignment; spatial scale is the whole active slot set; temporal scale is the full observed support. The discriminating failure condition is a batch with positive sign on joint_internal_RMS_A or joint_innovation_RMS_A, or a q value above 0.05. The permitted reward recipe that could express this is the pointcloud endpoint reward with region_index set to an evidence-bound landmark; the joint RMS term is not in the executing pointcloud scalar, so the hypothesis remains descriptive unless the region attention is validated.

A testable coordinate intervention on a time-conditioned contrast: observable is the observed-node linear contrast for a selected landmark feature; intended response is a sign-consistent change in the favorable-minus-comparison contrast; target origin is the landmark local coordinate field; spatial scale is the landmark radius 5.0 A; temporal scale is the observed support [0.0,0.49]. The discriminating failure condition is a sign change or strong sign conflict within the observed support, or a relative_node_RMSE above 0.35. The permitted reward recipe that could express this is the temporal_region_index with a verified continuous salience and temporal_teacher_blend in [0.25,0.5,1.0]; the contrast curve is not an absolute reward target, so the hypothesis remains descriptive unless the temporal region attention is validated.

A testable coordinate intervention on the turnover residual: observable is the turnover_residual_rate for a landmark local covariance feature; intended response is a reduction in the residual magnitude; target origin is the parent-child increment contrast; spatial scale is the landmark radius 5.0 A; temporal scale is the full observed support. The discriminating failure condition is a residual that is not larger than the population rate, or a positive_batch_fraction below 0.5. The permitted reward recipe that could express this is the pointcloud endpoint reward with region_index set to an evidence-bound landmark; the turnover residual is an accounting diagnostic, not a causal selection effect or atom velocity, so the hypothesis remains descriptive.

A testable coordinate intervention on regional enrichment: observable is the enrichment_z for a landmark local covariance feature; intended response is an increase in the favorable-minus-comparison contrast; target origin is the landmark region; spatial scale is the landmark radius 5.0 A; temporal scale is the full observed support. The discriminating failure condition is an enrichment_z with q above 0.05 or a positive_batch_fraction below 0.5. The permitted reward recipe that could express this is the pointcloud endpoint reward with region_index set to an evidence-bound landmark and teacher_neighbors in [2,4,8]; the enrichment_z is a diagnostic, not a physical interaction energy, so the hypothesis remains descriptive unless the region attention is validated.

A testable coordinate intervention on shape_yy: observable is the shape_yy covariance entry; intended response is a decrease in shape_yy; target origin is the global shape tensor; spatial scale is the whole active slot set; temporal scale is the full observed support. The discriminating failure condition is a sign disagreement between the raw and adjusted covariance forms, or a q value above 0.05. The permitted reward recipe that could express this is the pointcloud endpoint reward with region_index set to an evidence-bound landmark; shape_yy is an isolated marginal descriptor and the covariance and correlation forms disagree in sign, so the hypothesis remains descriptive.

limitations: Descendant credit is recorded joint-head credit at terminal index 99, not decoded terminal affinity; decoded_terminal_learning_labels_available is false.
Turnover residual includes score reclassification and extant-parent weighting, not only resampling; it is an accounting diagnostic, not a causal selection effect or atom velocity.
Adjusted branch covariance is supplied evidence; region moments themselves are not rigid-motion residuals.
Curve fitting does not establish causal benefit or a gradient; no time bins or outside-window analysis; extrapolation_allowed is false for all continuous rows.
Static teachers are last-learning-node forecasts, not actual final structures; teacher_modes temperature_edits is false.
All weak and null scalar effects retained; current study outcomes are withheld from design roles.
The executing pointcloud scalar has no pair-kernel, moment, joint-motif or geometry-block term; moment effects, pair kernels and turnover rates are diagnostic evidence only.
The information audit is not the full score-weighted reward or its FLOWR Jacobian; nonnegative excess distance is by construction, not a causal affinity effect.
Ancestral coverage is thin: 349 nodes have fewer than 3 ancestors and 531 fewer than 6, so survivor bias is expected.
The curve_support selected set (24 curves) is not the same as the audited set; the listed curve_fidelity_audit entries have relative_node_rmse 0.39-0.93 and strong_sign_conflict_nodes 0-15.
